How much vacation do I get?: Full-time employees accrue 1.5 days of paid vacation per month, up to 18 days per year.
Can I carry over unused vacation?: Up to 5 unused vacation days can be carried over into the next calendar year.
How long is parental leave?: Parental leave is 16 weeks at full pay for employees who have completed 6 months of service.
When are expense reports due?: Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of the purchase date.
What is the meal allowance when travelli: Meals during business travel are reimbursed up to $60 per day.
